instrument: City of Federal Way data center moratorium
summary: A 12-month moratorium applying to facilities at or above 1 MW or 4,000 square feet. Federal Way joins Seattle and Burien among Washington jurisdictions with pauses in force.
notes: At 1 MW, this is the lowest capacity threshold recorded in the register; Dubuque's is 75 MW and Tucson's is 20 MW. The spread across instruments using the same term is a standing finding.
confidence_note: Relayed; the ordinance has not been read.
